summary: Comprehensive E2E test for the massive tool-system refactor. BACKEND: 15/15 pytest pass (notes CRUD, folders CRUD, soft-delete/restore/permanent, nested folders promote-on-parent-delete, AI summarize). FRONTEND TABLET 1024x768: (a) Home + drawer + notes grid render fine; (b) Settings opens as a rounded floating right-side card (~476px wide with rounded corners + shadow) WITHOUT dimming the home behind it — backdrop backgroundColor=rgba(0,0,0,0), tap on the transparent backdrop closes settings; (c) Appearance (System/Light/Dark), all 8 accent chips (Sage/Blue/Purple/Rose/Amber/Ocean/Sunset/Graphite), Hide status bar toggle & Haptic feedback toggle present; accent recolors UI instantly (Purple -> rgb(139,122,168) then Blue -> rgb(91,123,194) live on the General tab pill); (d) long-press a note tile enters selection: bulk-action-bar renders at y=60 h=40 while first note row is at y=180 — does NOT cover the first row. FRONTEND PHONE 390x844 handwriting screen: all 11 toolbar buttons in correct top->bottom order (Undo, Redo, Touch on, Pen, Pencil, Marker, Tape, Select, Laser, Eraser, Ruler); 6 quick color slots at 18x18, thickness chip present. Ruler toggle activates (bg rgba(0,0,0,0) -> rgb(123,140,115)). Popovers: Pen shows 'Pen settings' title + Fountain/Ballpoint chips + '5.0 pt' thickness readout + 6 opt-quick chips + 'More colors…' expanding to 8x8 grid of 24x24 cells. Marker shows Flat tip/Round tip. Eraser shows Stroke erase/Area erase. Select shows 'Selection is coming soon'. Laser shows 'Laser is coming soon'. Quick-color grid picker Modal opens with 64 (8x8) cells at 22x22. Zoom pill reads '100%'; menu opens with 'Fit / 100%', '150%', '200%', '300%' + 'Save current' button. Long-press on zoom pill opens 'Save zoom' preset dialog with name input + Save/Cancel. Tab switching (Chrome-style OpenTabsStrip): swapping between 2 same-type handwriting tabs took 47ms with no loading indicators; closing active tab (X) instantly swaps to the other tab (URL updates in <600ms, screen already mounted). No pageerrors observed on any flow.

verification_matrix.tablet_settings_backdrop_close: PASS — click at (100,300) inside settings-backdrop unmounts settings-title

verification_matrix.tablet_selection_bar_no_cover_first_row: PASS — bar y=60,h=40; first note y=180
verification_matrix.phone_zoom_pill_100_and_menu_presets_and: PASS — Fit/100% (merged), 150%, 200%, 300%, Save current all present
verification_matrix.phone_zoom_pill_longpress_save_dialog: PASS — 'Save zoom' modal with name TextInput + Save/Cancel

issues: Zoom menu merges 'Fit' and '100%' into a single row 'Fit / 100%' instead of showing them as two discrete rows as the spec's '(Fit/100%/150%/200%/300%)' phrasing implies. Behaviorally identical when scale=1, but a strict reading of the review would want them separate. Minor/UX-decision — not a bug.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' at load. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: settings.tsx uses shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius on the floating card; OpenTabsStrip.tsx tab shadow*; several other components.

action_items: OPTIONAL/minor: If the spec really wants 5 discrete zoom rows, split 'Fit / 100%' into two entries in draw/[id].tsx zoom menu.
OPTIONAL: migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings across settings.tsx / OpenTabsStrip.tsx / draw/[id].tsx.
OPTIONAL/tech-debt: draw/[id].tsx is 3311 lines — consider splitting into modules (toolbar, popover, zoom-presets, persistence).
critical_code_review_comments: draw/[id].tsx is 3311 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Splitting the tool popover, zoom-preset dialog, and page-dims persistence into modules would drastically improve maintainability.
The tab-switching same-type shortcut (OpenTabsStrip.tsx line 82-86) is a nice touch — router.setParams keeps the screen mounted so there's no stack transition. Works flawlessly in test.
settings-backdrop is now fully transparent (backgroundColor rgba(0,0,0,0)) per the new 'no dimming' requirement — home is fully interactive-looking under the floating card. Matches spec exactly.

Family-tap popover behavior is correct: 1st tap on inactive family switches to it, 1st tap on already-active family opens the popover. Test agents should account for the 'already active' case (previously false-negative when double-tapping on the default-active Pen).

Backend model NoteBase.drawing_data is typed Optional[str] but front-end iteration_10 confirmed it's being persisted as a JSON string containing paperSize/orientation/paper — consistent with the string typing. No regression.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 20/20 verification items PASS. One minor UX deviation (Fit/100% merged) noted, non-blocking.

seed_data_creation: Created 2 handwriting notes (TEST_hw, TEST_hw2) via POST /api/notes for tab-switching tests; both permanent-deleted after tests (204 OK).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and every frontend flow in the review request pass. The Pen-family popover test previously appeared to fail because Pen is the DEFAULT active family on load, so double-tapping actually opens+closes the popover. The correct sequence is: switch to a different family first, then tap the target family twice. All other popover flows (Marker/Eraser/Select/Laser) worked with a simple double-tap because they start inactive. Zoom menu shows 'Fit / 100%' as one merged row — this may or may not match the spec; flag if needed.
